notes.rule: when the rest site offers both resting and smithing: rest below heal_below_hp_ratio of max HP, smith from it upwards (smith only while some upgrade has a positive value; otherwise the effect scores decide); the favoured action is lifted to lead by rule_margin points
notes.source: set by hand from the player's run history (260 rest decisions, 42 runs; scripts/analyze_rest_choices.py): heal rate 79% / 70% / 39% / 18% in the HP bands 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7; every half of the runs (older/newer and alternating ids) reads 0.6, and 0.6 scores 80.6-87.3% on the other half against 76.1-82.5% for 0.5
notes.not_used: the pre-boss rest site is rested at more often (HP 0.5-0.7: 70% against 39%), but a separate boss threshold did not beat the single threshold on held-out halves; elites ahead, act, potions and max HP showed no clear effect

notes.units: frontload/aoe/scaling: damage per turn; defense: block per turn; cycle: extra cards drawn per turn beyond the base hand (deck size acts through every card's draw rate, not here); energy: energy supply / energy demand
notes.needs: derived per upcoming fight from real encounter-pool HP/attack facts; only the ratios below are Guide-owned parameters
notes.fight_tempo: expected fight length relative to fight_turns = damage need / (frontload + scaling), bounded to [min, max]; the unblocked share of the defense need is multiplied by it (a faster deck takes less damage, a slower one more)
notes.pick_margin: a card is recommended only when its score beats skipping by more than pick_margin_by_act (added to skip's score). Set by hand from the player's run history (13 winning runs: skip rate 25% / 51% / 73% in acts 1 / 2 / 3) and checked on runs it was not set on; see scripts/analyze_skip_choices.py
notes.energy: energy limits how many drawn cards are played (a cap on every other dimension); its own weight is 0 so it is not counted twice
notes.orb_slots: assembly: Defect.get_BaseOrbSlotCount = 3, CharacterModel default 0; OrbCmd.Channel adds 1 slot when a player with none channels
notes.encounters: needs come from encounter and monster facts: real line-ups, per-turn attack and hits walked from each monster's move state machine; ActModel.NumberOfWeakEncounters is 3 for Overgrowth/Underdocks and 2 for Hive/Glory (the act's first normal fights use its weak pool); Frail multiplies card block by 0.75 (powers:FRAIL)

card_reward_odds.source: assembly CardRarityOdds via AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension(level 7, ascension value, base value): regular common 0.6 (A7 0.615), uncommon 0.37, rare 0.03 (A7 0.0149); elite common 0.5 (A7 0.549), uncommon 0.4, rare 0.1 (A7 0.05); boss rare 1; rare offset starts at -0.05
